scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,API,DESKTOP "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build:api && npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop
scripts.package:prepare: npm run browser:install && npm run build && npm run runtime:prepare && node scripts/validate-package-inputs.mjs
scripts.package:win: npm run package:prepare && electron-forge package --config forge.config.cjs --platform=win32 --arch=x64
scripts.make:win: npm run package:prepare && electron-forge make --config forge.config.cjs --platform=win32 --arch=x64
scripts.make:win:clean: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force out -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force packaging -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue" && npm run make:win
